type: Original flat raster UI control atlas for Koko welcome screen
goal: One transparent bitmap atlas with 2 columns and 2 rows, four equal square quadrants. These are production button and consent skins. Must be genuinely transparent outside the drawn assets.

visual_tone.aesthetic: Crisp flat minimal precision, confident social app, no gloss, no shadows, no gradients, no 3D bevels

centerpiece.description: Top-left quadrant: centered wide horizontal rounded-rectangle button skin with uniform mint #B9EDCE fill, width 90% of quadrant, height 30% of quadrant, modest 12% of height corner radius, perfectly flat, no text or icon. Top-right quadrant: identical size and radius button skin, deep green #102522 interior, thin clearly visible soft-sage #9CC1B2 outline, no text/icon. Bottom-left quadrant: centered compact square checkbox, softly rounded corners, thin soft-sage outline, transparent interior, occupying 42% of quadrant width, no shadow. Bottom-right quadrant: identically sized mint-filled square checkbox with one crisp dark-green checkmark, modest rounded corners. All four exact positions centered in their equal quadrants, no dividers, no labels.

must_keep: No horizontal lines crossing button interiors
